Hi All,

 

Please be advised that there will be planned outage on the CPQ platform cause by SAP maintenance on the following dates and times:

 

              Friday, 19th April 2024 10:30pm EST to Sunday, 21st Apr 2024 10:30am EST

 

During this window, the follow services will not be available.

 

CPQ Get Pricing

SFDC will work as normal.

This means:

             Quotes in the pre-Get Pricing status will not be processed.

             Quotes that have had Get Pricing can go for approval.

             Quotes that have been approved will not be replicated in SAP.

If you can avoid using CPQ during this period, it will reduce the chance of issues after.

 

Please manage your workload around this shutdown.

 

Should you have any issues on Monday, please raise an OnIT ticket here.

 

Regards,

SFDC IT Team
